visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands are shown under a silver faucet with running water in a white sink, rubbing together to demonstrate washing. White text overlays appear on the hands as they move. (2) A close-up of a forearm reveals several colorful cosmetic swatches (brown, orange, peach). A hand rubs these swatches vigorously under the running water, yet they remain perfectly intact and do not smudge. (3) A woman with long green hair and a black top appears on camera, her face bisected by a vertical dotted white line. The left side is labeled for anti-aging and the right for maturity. (4) Static images of a female celebrity are displayed side-by-side to show the difference in appearance with and without specific eye makeup styles. (5) The main woman returns to the frame, using a small brush to carefully apply a light-colored cosmetic product to her lower eyelid area. (6) She holds four black and white makeup sticks towards the camera while speaking with varied facial expressions and hand gestures. (7) An extreme close-up focuses on her eye as she applies different shades of the eye shadow sticks to her lower lid and blends them with her fingertip. (8) The woman uses a makeup brush to blend eye shadow on her upper eyelid, showing the smooth application of the product. (9) She poses for the camera with a completed look, then the scene cuts to a row of Bobbi Brown shadow sticks laid out on a white surface. (10) Footage shows her in a public transit area, looking into her phone camera to show how well the makeup has lasted throughout the day in an outdoor environment. (11) Back in an indoor setting, she applies a brown shade to the side of her nose to demonstrate using the product as a contour. (12) A forearm with eight different colored swatches is shown, each labeled with a specific shade name in white text. (13) In the final segment, she poses in a montage of high-angle shots against a blue background, displaying her finished makeup under studio lighting with a clock in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the bright, splashing sound of running water from a tap and the friction of hands rubbing together. Simultaneously, a high-tempo, major-mode electronic pop background music kicks in with a clear 4/4 synthetic beat. (2) A female voice enters, speaking Mandarin with high arousal and a bright, excited tone. Her speech is rapid and enthusiastic. A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition to the smudge test discussion. (3) As the narrator describes her makeup struggles, a clock ticking sound effect is heard over the music, followed by a 'pop' bubble sound effect when the '10 minutes later' text appears visually. (4) The music continues at a steady pace, and the vocal delivery becomes more assertive. Frequent 'whoosh' transition sound effects are interspersed between the narrator's sentences as she starts the tutorial. (5) A rhythmic 'ding-ding' sound effect accompanies the display of specific makeup shades. The narrator's pitch rises when she expresses her amazement at the product's durability. (6) In the final phase, the narration ends, and the electronic music swells slightly in volume, featuring a dominant synthesizer melody and percussive drum machine hits to close the video with a series of quick rhythmic cuts.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Social Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional tutorial for Bobbi Brown Long-Wear Cream Shadow Sticks. It uses a high-energy, fast-paced format to capture attention with a smudge-proof 'hook', followed by a demonstration of the product's versatility for eye bags, eyeshadow, and contouring, ultimately proving its durability through an 8-hour wear test.
